props.gloss_en: the mishna (lemma): how are these more than the first? only that in these they sound the alarm and lock the shops
with what do they sound the alarm? Rav Yehuda: with shofarot
Rav (as transmitted by Rav Yehuda son of Rav Shmuel bar Shilat): with Aneinu
it entered our mind: the one who said with Aneinu did not say with shofarot, and the one who said with shofarot did not say with Aneinu
the baraita: one does not decree fewer than seven fasts on the community, in which there are eighteen alarms
and a mnemonic for the matter: Jericho
and Jericho was shofarot
rather: about shofarot, all agree that it is called hatra'a
where they dispute is Aneinu: one master holds it is called hatra'a, and one master holds it is not called hatra'a
according to the one who said with Aneinu -- all the more so with shofarot
the alarm is with Aneinu -- which, according to the one who said with shofarot, it is not (the stam denies it on his behalf: but with Aneinu, not)

the baraita: and all other kinds of calamities that break out -- such as scabs, locusts, flies and hornets and mosquitoes, and the sending of snakes and scorpions -- they would not sound the alarm but cry out
it is a tannaitic dispute
the mishna: for these they sound the alarm on Shabbat -- for a city that troops surrounded
or a river [surrounded]
and for a ship tossed about at sea
R' Yosei: for help
but not for crying out
if you say [the mishna's Shabbat alarm is] with shofarot
rather, is it not with Aneinu -- and it calls it hatra'a; learn from this
